subject: math
description: Derive and apply the side relationships in 45-45-90 triangles to find missing side lengths.
learningObjectives: Derive the 45-45-90 triangle relationship from the diagonal of a square
Identify the side ratio x:x:x sqrt(2) in an isosceles right triangle
Find the hypotenuse when a leg is given
Find each leg when the hypotenuse is given
Choose whether to multiply or divide by sqrt(2)
Check missing side answers for reasonableness
prerequisites: Recognize right triangles and angle measures
Simplify square roots such as sqrt(50) = 5sqrt(2)
Solve one-step equations involving multiplication and division
